name: ClickHouse Server
notes: Exact 26.8 LTS build tag. Upstream Apache license does not license every bundled library. Foreign investment disclosed; no current cap table/control rights supplied. Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-clickhouse (images/clickhouse/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-clickhouse:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image. Vulnerability scans and licence evidence still target the upstream reference.

Deployed as the ironlog image ironlog-grafana (images/grafana/Dockerfile), built FROM the pinned upstream in "image"; Compose builds it locally (ironlog-grafana:local), Quadlets reference quadlet_image.
